summary: You can see at a glance which environment and tenant every mail comes from.

new.title: Every mail names its environment
new.text: Alert, report and test mails now show the environment in the subject, and the first line names the environment and tenant. Without a tenant name in Settings, your directory's own name is used.

new.title: Slow pages are caught earlier
new.text: The Invardia support link now also reports the health of the database statistics, so Invardia support can catch a slowing page early.
